# ring homomorphism　`def.ring-hom`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.ring-hom)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.ring-hom.md)

⚠ Some texts do not require $f(1_R) = 1_S$; these notes use the convention "rings with identity and homomorphisms preserving $1$". Without preserving $1$ the kernel is still an ideal, but "$R/\ker f \cong \operatorname{im} f$" then requires aligning the identity of the image (the $1$ of the image).

⭐ First isomorphism theorem: $R/\ker f \cong \operatorname{im} f$ (for quotient rings see `def.quotient-ring`).

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
